minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  September 26, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, September 26,
2019, at 2:04 pm in the Community Room A, 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk’s
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Ikemefuna asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Ikemefuna reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
September 12, 2019.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Cinder Eller to host Cinder’s Tailgate Birthday Party at the Cuban Leaf
  Cigar Lounge at 424 E. Florence in the Parking Lot, on Sunday, October 6,
  2019, from 10:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m.; 1 day parking lot event; Applicant
  responsible for crowd control and event clean up; Applicant to notify other
  tenants using parking lot; Applicant to hire (3) professional licensed security
  guards with reflective vests for safety of attendees; One of the security
  guard's to be stationed at the beer garden to ensure that there is NO
  underage alcohol consumption; No vehicular traffic where pedestrians are
  present / walking around; Applicant to comply with applicable noise
  standards for DJ (IMC Article 2 - Noise Regulations) and adhere to all
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations and local, state
  and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00277099)
 Permits & License Committee  September 26, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

Item #2:  Etna Cisneros DBA Mothers Nutritional Center to host its Re-Grand
  Opening Produce Event at 943 N. La Brea Avenue, on Saturday, October
  12, 2019, from 8:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m.; one day event within parking lot of
  shopping center; Applicant to notify all tenants of shopping center in
  advance; Applicant responsible for crowd control and event clean up; Per
  the applicant, only two parking spaces needed to prop up produce displays;
  Applicant to hire (1) professional / licensed security guard w/ reflective vest
  for potential crowd control and safety of employees & customers; and
  adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations
  and local, state and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No.
  00277025)

Item #3:  Daniel Kash DBA LAX Firing Range Inc., to host LAX Firing Range Parking
  Lot Sale at 234 Hindry Avenue, on Saturday, October 19, 2019 and
  Sunday, October 20, 2019, from 9:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.; Approval for 2 day
  event in parking lot; Applicant responsible for crowd control and event clean
  up. Applicant to notify other tenants using parking lot. Sale of Sporting
  Goods only; Applicant to hire adequate professional / licensed security
  guards wearing reflective vests for potential crowd control and safety of
  employees and customers; NO vehicular traffic or vehicular movement in
  the same areas where pedestrians are present / walking; and adhere to all
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations and local, state
  and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00277079)

Item #4:  Rick Miller & Tom Beckley DBA Inglewood Park Cemetery and Inglewood
  Park Mortuary to host Dia de Los Muertos Cultural Festival at 720 E.
  Florence Avenue, on Sunday, October 20, 2019, from 11:30 a.m. - 4:00
  p.m.; Approval for one day event at cemetery. Applicant responsible for
  crowd control and event clean up; Inglewood Park Security guards wearing
  reflective vests for potential crowd control and safety of employees and
  customers staff this event. IPD to provide extra patrol & high visibility. IPD
  watch commander will be notified as well; and adhere to all applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations and local, state and
  federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00276877)

Item #5:  Alexis Roberts DBA Center of Hope to host Light the Night Harvest Festival
  at 8th Avenue between Hardy Street and 94th Street, on Thursday, October
  31, 2019, from 5:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m.; Approval for one day event; Applicant
  responsible for crowd control and event clean up; (7) TCO's required for
  street closures and traffic control; (2) IPD officers for public safety, in
  addition to the (6) "off-duty" personnel already scheduled to work the event;
  Applicant to conduct waiver / surveys of residents that maybe affected by
  the event (residents on 8th Ave, 94 & 95 Streets); LA.CO. Fire notification
  and first aid station required in the event of minor injury incident; IPD Watch
  Commander will be notified to provide extra patrol as time permits;
  approved encroachment permit for street closure through Public Works;
  Signatures from the residents whose property are adjacent to the closure;
  permit requestor will house their trash management on their private
 Permits & License Committee  September 26, 2019
Minutes  Page 3 of 4

  property; and adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations and local, state and federal laws. Motion carried and second.
  (Activity No. 00277040)

Item #6:  Betty B. Luckett DBA From the Heart Childcare & Enrichment Center to
  host a Harvest Festival at 1061 E. Hyde Park Blvd. (Closure: Long St;
  Fairview Blvd. to Hyde Park Blvd.), on Friday, November 1, 2019, from 3:00
  p.m. - 6:00 p.m.; Approval for one day event; Applicant responsible for
  crowd control and event clean-up; (2) TCO's required from 1200-1900
  hours for street closure on Long St, between Hydepark & Fairview;
  Security (parents of children are off-duty police officers) to wear reflective
  vests for high visibility; IPD watch commander will be notified and extra
  patrol provided as time permits; Public Works approved encroachment
  permit for street closure; permit request will house their trash management
  on their private property. No recommendation from PW/Environmental
  Services Division; and adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations and local, state and federal laws. Motion carried and
  second. (Activity No. 00276919)

Item #7:  Rick Miller DBA Inglewood Park Cemetery to host a Veterans Day
  Celebration at 720 E. Florence Avenue, on Monday, November 11, 2019,
  from 11:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. Approval for one day event at cemetery.
  Applicant responsible for crowd control and event clean up; Inglewood Park
  Security guards wearing reflective vests for potential crowd control and
  safety of employees and customers staff this event. IPD to provide extra
  patrol & high visibility. IPD watch commander will be notified as well; and
  adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations
  and local, state and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No.
  00276876)

Tobacco Retailers License Renewal Request(s):

Item #81:  A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE the following
  list of tobacco retailer businesses renewals with standard
  recommendations. Motion carried unanimously.

  license renewals, subject to payment of business tax; adhere to all
  applicable IMC regulations, state and federal law and standard business
  recommendation applicable. Motion carried and second.

  Business Name  Business Type  Activity No.

Public Comments
Chairman Ikemefuna asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any matters connected with items on the Agenda, it was
reported that there were no public requests to speak.

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:25 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
